verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the CLI docs: built-in and MCP tools fall under a 'permission system' with access controllable 'at multiple levels', and Devin Review Auto-Fix can be enabled to act automatically on review comments and CI failures. Neither describes named autonomy tiers or what actions skip manual confirmation. Missing for 10: documented tiered autonomy modes, per-action confirmation/approval rules, org-level admin enforcement by an engineering lead, coverage beyond the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
